verdict.rationale: First-party docs show fast availability checks, with bulk search results 'in seconds' and a suggestion tool that checks availability 'instantly across top TLDs'. They also show alternate-TLD suggestions through AI Domain Search across 600+ extensions. Nothing in the evidence addresses the 'honest' part of the story: no policy or commitment against front-running or squatting on searched names. missing for 10: an explicit no-front-running or search-privacy commitment, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search speed and suggestion quality.
